recommendations.summary: Keep recommendation rationale scoring behind concrete planning evidence.
recommendations.rationale: Two grounded evidence refs and explicit tradeoffs make this recommendation emission-ready.
tradeoffs: Adds a stricter pre-emission bar, which can defer thin recommendations until more evidence is collected.
Keeps packet quality high at the cost of rejecting superficially plausible ideas.

recommendations.summary: Ship a recommendation after citing only one supporting artifact.
recommendations.rationale: The idea is directionally useful, but it only cites one source artifact today.
tradeoffs: Moves faster now but risks over-indexing on a single source.

recommendations.summary: Emit a recommendation without naming what it delays or constrains.
recommendations.rationale: The evidence base is sufficient, but the operator-facing tradeoffs are not articulated yet.
